title: infosigasp
text: R package providing programmatic interface INFOSIGA-SP (São Paulo State Traffic Accident Information Management System, maintained DETRAN-SP). downloads imports tidy data frames three linked datasets: sinistros (crash events), pessoas (victims), veiculos (vehicles), 2015 .

title: infosigasp
text: Two-function public API. read_infosiga() dictionary_infosiga() exported. Downloading, caching transformations implementation details reached arguments functions. Explicit processing modes. read_infosiga() supports "raw" (fields character source representations preserved), "typed" (declared R classes without cleaning) default "clean" modes. cleaning logic lives .infosiga_clean() must stay idempotent. Faithful layer, harmonisation layer. .infosiga_clean() fixes types missing-value markers never renames columns, recodes category labels drops rows. Conservative label harmonisation belongs .infosiga_standardize(), users select standardize. Analytical recoding reshaping outside initial release scope. Original column names preserved (Portuguese). anglicise ; users cross-reference official data dictionary (dictionary_infosiga()). cache never poisoned bad download. Downloads go tempfile, validated (non-empty + ZIP magic bytes via .infosiga_is_zip()), copied cache. failed refresh leaves existing archive intact. Mirror fallback. infosigasp.zip_url infosigasp.dictionary_url may vector URLs tried order. default zip_url falls back data-current GitHub release, .github/workflows/refresh-data-mirror.yaml re-uploads weekly whenever DETRAN-SP archive hash changes. tag rolls; never pin dated one. Refresh reader. read_infosiga(refresh = TRUE) public update path. first interactive download asks confirmation reports approximate 120 MB size; explicit refreshes prompt .

title: Getting started with infosigasp
text: INFOSIGA-SP São Paulo State Traffic Incident Information Management System, maintained DETRAN-SP. publishes open occurrence records 2015 onward. Coverage definitions vary time: 2015–2018 covers fatal crashes , events table also contains notifications yet confirmed crashes. infosigasp downloads imports records. handles makes raw files awkward read directly. files use Latin-1 (ISO-8859-1), UTF-8. Semicolons (;) separate fields. Decimal numbers, coordinates, use comma decimal mark. Dates follow DD/MM/YYYY. dataset spans two files (2015–2021 2022 onward).
code: library(infosigasp)

title: Getting started with infosigasp
text: INFOSIGA-SP organises data three linked tables. sinistros — occurrence records. One row per confirmed crash notification, date, time, location (including latitude/longitude), road attributes breakdown many vehicles victims involved, type severity. pessoas — people (victims). One row per person involved, demographic attributes, injury severity , fatalities, date place death. veiculos — vehicles. One row per vehicle involved, make/model, manufacturing model years, colour type. three share id_sinistro key, can joined together; pessoas veiculos additionally share id_veiculo.

title: Getting started with infosigasp
text: read_infosiga() separates tabular import, type parsing cleaning processing argument. Every mode decodes Latin-1 UTF-8, parses CSV structure combines period files. Raw mode therefore lossless tabular representation rather byte--byte copy source archive. Choose mode according task: use "raw" audit source values, "typed" parse documented classes retaining source labels padding, default "clean" mode analysis. modes retain import diagnostics attr(x, "problems"); typed clean modes replace values fail declared parser NA, raw mode preserves field text. Typed mode parses full dates Date, times hms, numeric fields integer double, empty fields NA. Identifiers remain character preserve leading zeros avoid integer overflow. Clean mode applies following transformations: Year-month dates. ano_mes_* columns (published "YYYY/MM") become first--month Date values. Whitespace. Text columns lose leading trailing whitespace. source pads fields fixed width (nacionalidade ships "BRASILEIRA          "); untrimmed, values break grouping joins. Missing values. "NAO DISPONIVEL" (“available”) marker becomes NA (trimming runs first, space-padded markers caught). dia_da_semana: Domingo < … < Sábado (Brazilian week starts Sunday); turno: MADRUGADA < MANHA < TARDE < NOITE; gravidade_lesao (victims): LEVE < GRAVE < FATAL; faixa_etaria_demografica / faixa_etaria_legal: age bands order. Crash-type flags. binary tp_sinistro_* columns ("S" / empty) become logical, can sum() filter directly. categorical tp_sinistro_primario stays text. Counts. Missing qtd_* entries remain NA, including another vehicle injury-severity count available crash. Clean mode infer unreported count zero. Numeric strings. tempo_sinistro_obito (days crash death) becomes integer, numero_logradouro loses spurious trailing ".0" export appends ("193.0"). Coordinates. Coordinate pairs outside São Paulo state boundary 2 km buffer become NA. buffer retains plausible near-border records, spatial test rejects extreme malformed values, (0, 0) placeholders points elsewhere inside state’s rectangular extent. rows dropped; typed raw modes preserve coordinates validation. converting ordinal, flag integer column, clean mode validates observed representations. finds unexpected value, preserves entire column warns; class can therefore remain character upstream change. safeguards apply closed-domain conversions, every parsed column. example, malformed numeric coordinate can become NA typed import listed attr(x, "problems"). dia_da_semana ordered factor, weekday tabulation comes calendar order rather alphabetically.
code: raw <- read_infosiga("sinistros", processing = "raw") typed <- read_infosiga("sinistros", processing = "typed") clean <- read_infosiga("sinistros", processing = "clean") sinistros <- read_infosiga("sinistros") levels(sinistros$dia_da_semana) table(sinistros$dia_da_semana)

title: Getting started with infosigasp
text: Clean mode harmonize nominal categories beyond documented missing-value rule. Select harmonizations need standardize. Vehicle colour clearest case. source carries dozens distinct values sixteen real colours, two upstream systems coexist every year, one upper-case one title-cased, two disagree gender agreement. Note toupper() alone merge Branca Branco. Detailed liveries multi-tone values remain unchanged grouping analytical recode rather label harmonization. remaining changes listed . "municipios". Municipality names take official IBGE spelling, matched cod_ibge; INFOSIGA administrative-region names receive consistent accents case without changing classification. "profissoes". Occupations title-cased, merges values differ capitalisation. Known nonresponse markers—including variants "NAO INFORMADA", "SEM INFORMACAO" "DESCONHECIDO"—become NA. Use standardize = c("municipios", "profissoes") combine options, standardize = "" every option applicable selected dataset. profissao keeps unaccented spelling occupations stay ungrouped authoritative list covers free-text values. Standardization requires processing = "clean".
code: veiculos <- read_infosiga("veiculos", standardize = "cores")  sort(table(veiculos$cor_veiculo), decreasing = TRUE)

title: Getting started with infosigasp
text: Always join cod_ibge, never name. IBGE INFOSIGA-SP spell nine municipalities differently. Eight contain apostrophe INFOSIGA-SP renders space ("Santa Bárbara d'Oeste" "SANTA BARBARA D OESTE"), IBGE’s "São Luiz Paraitinga" appears "SAO LUIS PARAITINGA". name join loses nine silently. cod_ibge also standard Brazilian municipality key, joins INFOSIGA-SP census population data. denominators turn crash counts crash rates.

title: infosigasp 0.2.0
text: Coordinate validation now uses São Paulo state boundary 2 km buffer instead rectangular bounding box. Documented important changes source-data coverage definitions, including 2015–2018 covers fatal crashes sinistros includes unconfirmed notifications. Missing qtd_* counts now remain NA cleaning blank source value establish zero count. Simplified public API: read_infosiga() dictionary_infosiga() now exported functions; download, cache, update, data-listing, cleaning label-standardization helpers internal implementation details. (#20) dictionary_infosiga() replaces infosiga_dictionary(), downloads official PDF dictionaries datasets selected dataset, links searchable online data dictionary. (#20) read_infosiga() now supports explicit "raw", "typed" "clean" processing modes, "clean" remaining default. (#22) read_infosiga() now supports selective label standardization standardize = "municipios", "cores", "profissoes" "", preserving source categories harmonized safely. (#22) read_infosiga() now preserves unexpected categorical, flag integer representations emits warning instead silently coercing . (#22) read_infosiga() longer accepts non-pushdown year argument; filter ano_sinistro import year subset needed. (#20)

title: infosigasp 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Added read_infosiga(), downloads (caching) imports three INFOSIGA-SP datasets (sinistros, pessoas veiculos) tidy tibbles, handling source encoding, decimal marks date formats. Added clean_infosiga(), applied default, trims text, maps "NAO DISPONIVEL" NA, makes ordinal columns ordered factors, parses ano_mes_* columns first--month Dates, turns tp_sinistro_* crash-type flags logical, fills blank qtd_* counts 0 inside otherwise-populated count block, casts tempo_sinistro_obito integer, strips spurious ".0" numero_logradouro, voids coordinates outside São Paulo state bounding box. Added clean = FALSE read_infosiga() raw data published. Added tidy_infosiga_labels(), opt-second pass rewrites category labels analysts need published categories verbatim: IBGE spellings municipio regiao_administrativa, merged cor_veiculo spellings, Title Cased profissao, route codes split conservacao new conservacao_codigo column. Added infosiga_municipios dataset, pairing official IBGE name INFOSIGA-SP spelling São Paulo municipality, keyed cod_ibge. Added infosiga_download() pre-fetch source archive, falling back GitHub-release mirror DETRAN-SP endpoint unavailable; mirrors go infosigasp.zip_url option. Responses checked ZIP signature cached, portal serving error page 200 status falls next mirror instead poisoning cache. Added warning read_infosiga() infosiga_download() reuses cached archive whose data older infosigasp.stale_days option (30 days default; set Inf disable), since DETRAN-SP refreshes data monthly file name. age CSVs inside archive rather downloaded file, warning names date carry. describes local copy ; use infosiga_check_update() compare remote source. Added infosiga_check_update(), reports whether archive published package mirror newer cached copy. reads small manifest describing mirrored archive rather archive . weekly GitHub Actions job re-fetches official archive republishes mirror whenever contents change, mirror can trail DETRAN-SP week. infosigasp.manifest_url accepts vector mirrors tried order, matching infosigasp.zip_url. Added infosiga_cache_dir(), infosiga_cache_list() infosiga_cache_clear() manage -disk cache. Added infosiga_datasets(), lists available datasets keys, infosiga_dictionary(), downloads official data dictionary. infosigasp.dictionary_url accepts vector mirrors tried order, matching infosigasp.zip_url. Added package hex logo drawn major road network São Paulo Metropolitan Region INFOSIGA-SP dark blue (data-raw/logo.R).
